# AI Market Research Tool — Understand Any Market in Minutes, Not Weeks

 Generate comprehensive market analysis briefs with AI. Research market size, industry trends, competitive landscapes, customer segments, and growth opportunities — all structured into professional, citation-backed reports. 

An AI market analysis tool generates market analysis briefs — market sizing, competitive landscape, customer segments, and growth opportunities — through a multi-stage pipeline that checks your figures against the source documents you uploaded and adds automatic [1], [2] citations. Gixo's version turns this into a structured brief with 20+ semantic blocks (KPIs, Comparison Tables, Pros/Cons, CTAs) in minutes instead of the 1-2 weeks an in-house analyst or 4-8 weeks a research firm typically takes. Cited claims point to uploaded files, but the model can omit a marker. Review citations, source definitions and the proposed interpretation; brand checks do not establish factual accuracy.

As a market research tool, Gixo sits on the analysis side of the category rather than the data side. You bring the evidence — industry reports, analyst PDFs, survey and analytics exports, internal sales figures — and Gixo produces the written market research deliverable, with the figures in the draft reconciled against those uploads and [1], [2] citations attached. It is not a live market-data provider and does not field surveys or run panels, so the brief is only as good as the sources you give it.

A real Gixo Business workspace — a Business Brief — a market deep-dive on EV fleet adoption. Generated from uploaded source material for review, not a final or certified recommendation.

## What Does an AI Market Analysis Tool Actually Analyze?

Get the market research that would take an analyst team weeks — structured, sourced, and ready for strategic planning.

Market Sizing and Trends

Analyze total addressable market, growth rates, and emerging trends across any industry. Gixo's number checks stage checks your market sizing figures against the source documents you uploaded so they trace back to your sources.

Customer Segmentation

Identify target segments, buyer personas, and purchasing patterns with Comparison Table blocks for side-by-side segment analysis. Brand compliance applies your Brand Dictionary's preferred and banned terms, so the output uses your organization's terminology; voice is yours to review.

Competitive Landscape

Map key competitors, their market positions, strengths, and weaknesses using Pros/Cons blocks. Competitive claims taken from your uploaded sources carry [1], [2] citations, so stakeholders can trace them back to those sources.

Opportunity Analysis

Discover untapped opportunities and emerging niches with CTA blocks for recommended actions. Choose from 59 curated recipes or describe your market, then save the analysis to a workspace for real-time collaboration with your strategy team.

Evidence-Based Insights

Findings taken from your uploaded sources carry inline [1], [2] citations with a Sources section. The multi-stage pipeline checks your figures against your sources and adds references so you present market intelligence to stakeholders with confidence.

Executive-Ready Format

Market analysis briefs use the block-based editor with 20+ semantic blocks including KPIs, Comparison Tables, and CTAs. Edit any section with Quick AI for instant rewrites or Power Edit for full AI dialog.

## How Do You Create an AI Market Analysis Brief?

Define your market or industry

Enter the market, industry, or sector you want to analyze. Be as specific or broad as needed — from "global SaaS market" to "organic pet food in North America."

Specify your research focus

Choose what aspects to emphasize — market sizing, competitive landscape, customer segments, trends, regulatory environment, or a comprehensive analysis.

AI generates your market brief

The multi-stage pipeline generates content, checks your figures against the source documents you uploaded, adds automatic [1], [2] citations, applies your Brand Dictionary terms, and checks word count and structure.

Enhance and distribute

Edit with 20+ semantic blocks including KPIs, Comparison Tables, and CTAs. Use Quick AI for instant rewrites or Power Edit for full AI dialog. Save to a workspace for real-time collaboration, then export to PDF.

## What Kind of Market Research Tool Is This?

"Market research tool" covers two different products. Knowing which one you are shopping for saves a wasted trial.

### Data tools supply the numbers; analysis tools produce the document

One half of the category supplies evidence: survey and panel platforms that field questionnaires, traffic and audience estimators, syndicated report libraries, and industry databases. The other half turns that evidence into something a decision-maker can actually read — a market research report with a stated scope, sized assumptions, a competitive picture, and references. Gixo is the second kind. It is a market research tool in the sense that it produces the market research deliverable, not in the sense that it sells you market data.

The split matters most when you compare prices. A data subscription is priced against the panel, sample, or database behind it, and you still have to write the analysis afterwards. An analysis tool is priced against the structuring and writing work, and you still have to bring the evidence. Plenty of teams end up paying for one of each, which is a reasonable stack as long as neither is expected to do the other's job.

### What you bring, and what the tool does with it

You supply the inputs: industry reports and analyst PDFs, exports from your survey or analytics platform, pricing pages and public filings you have collected, internal sales and pipeline figures. The multi-stage pipeline then drafts the brief, reconciles the figures in it against those uploads, attaches inline [1], [2] citations with a Sources section, applies your Brand Dictionary terms, and lays the result out in 20+ semantic blocks — KPI blocks for sizing, Comparison Tables for the competitive set, Pros/Cons for entry options. From there you edit with Quick AI or Power Edit, share the workspace with your strategy team, and export to PDF.

### What this market research tool does not do

It is not a live market-data provider. It does not field surveys, run consumer panels, license syndicated data, estimate a competitor's traffic or market share on its own, or conduct interviews and other primary research. A figure that is not in the sources you supplied is not a sourced figure, and the number checks stage reconciles claims against your uploads rather than confirming the underlying data is correct. Review every source, number, inference, and recommendation before the brief informs an investment or operating decision.
